title: Welcome to Quay Street
text: Start with **Floor** (`F`) in the build bar: drag across the foundation for the ground floor and a basement. The game runs while you build; press `Space` to pause.

title: Building floors
text: Drag across the columns. Each floor must rest on the one below; basements only where the foundation has been dug. `Esc` puts the tool away.

title: Placing rooms
text: Drag to set the width; the preview shows the price, or in red why it cannot go there. Rooms need a floor at their level.

title: Stairs and elevators
text: Drag a shaft upward across the floors it should serve. Rooms in the way are cut to make room. Drag its top or bottom later to resize it.

title: Demolishing
text: Click a room to remove it, or an empty floor. You get 40 % of the cost back; `⌘Z` undoes it for the full amount.

title: Your first tenant
text: Someone signed a lease. Click the unit to see who moved in, what they pay and how happy they are. Rent comes in at the 06:00 closing.

title: Prospects missing services
text: A prospect declined because a utility is missing or rooms are dirty or worn. Check the **Facilities** panel (`⌥⌘F`) and the **Services overlay** (`⌥⌘U`).

title: Hard to reach
text: A prospect found a unit too slow to reach. Add an elevator, or check the waits in **Elevator Banks** (`⌥⌘E`).

title: Too expensive
text: A prospect found the rent too high. Lower the **Rent level** in the Economy panel, or one unit's rent in its inspector.

title: The daily closing
text: At 06:00 rent came in and the running costs went out. The **Economy** panel (`⌥⌘M`) shows every category for today and the last seven days.

title: Night falls
text: Homes light up and offices go dark. Lighting costs electricity, billed at the closing. Tenants review their units every morning.

title: Cash below zero
text: Seven closings in a row in the red means bankruptcy. Borrow in the Economy panel, sell a flat or let more units.

title: Fire!
text: Everyone leaves by the stairs and the brigade is on its way. A **Fire Control Room** runs sprinklers for 15 floors up and down.

title: An elevator broke down
text: A worn car stopped. A technician repairs it first thing; hire technicians in the Facilities panel and build a staff room for them.

title: A better class
text: Your building went up a class: taller floors, new rooms and new tenants are unlocked. The **Standing** panel (`⌥⌘P`) shows what the next class needs.
